ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Funds at Risk
ideas.description: Investigate the 'serious fraud problem' that led to the Trump administration withholding Minnesota's Medicaid funds.
ideas.angle: Follow the money: track the flow of Medicaid funds and identify potential entities involved in the fraud.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant issue with Minnesota's Medicaid program and potentially lead to further investigations and reforms.
